C0241.title: China accused of flooding social media with spam to crowd out coverage of lockdown protests
C0241.summary: In December 2022, China was accused of using spam to flood social media platforms in order to suppress coverage of COVID-19 lockdown protests. A large volume of fake or repetitive posts was used to disrupt normal information dissemination, degrading user experience and raising compliance concerns.
